_about: Hand-written Thorvald/Ginaz examples for docs/attribute_catalog.md. Edit freely; gen_attribute_catalog.py prefers these over house_ginaz/mechanics/mechanics.json and over its generated ideas. Values: _Flat = a plain number, _ARatio = an added fraction (0.15 = +15%), _MRatio = a multiplier (0.8 = -20%, 0 = none). Designs: house_thorvald/faction_design.md, counsellors.md, heroes.md, operations.md; house_ginaz/faction_design.md.

attributes.TUnit_ImportCost_TRes2_MRatio: Thorvald · Iron Guard: one row per unit, val `0`, target `Th_Trooper`, target2 `Manpower` → recruiting costs no Manpower. Vanilla precedent: Corrino `C_Hero_2_FactionBuff` uses 0.8 on `C_Elite`.
